status.transportSetting: (mail.transport is {setting}; this realm is in {mode} mode)
status.captureBefore: Development: every message is KEPT and shown on
status.off: Nothing is sent: a message is refused as it is queued (STS-MAIL-0001).
status.builtOk: no failure recorded in this process
status.linksUnpinned: (the listener's configured address: global.publicBaseUrl is empty, which product mode refuses)
status.linksNowhere: nowhere — set global.publicBaseUrl; a message with a link is refused until then (STS-MAIL-0015)
status.resetOffered: offered where a transport is available
cannot.head: This realm cannot send mail
cannot.before: . Configure a transport below; until then these forms, the emailed sign-in mechanisms on
test.heading: Send a test message
test.note: To your own entry's address, or to another person in this realm by username. Never to an address.
verify.heading: Verify a person's address
verify.note: Sends a single-use verification link to the address on their entry; they follow it. You never see it. A person can send themselves one from /portal/email.
templates.heading: Messages
templates.note: Every message this service sends, in English, and the languages this realm has written its own wording in. A person's preferredLanguage chooses. A link is a placeholder whose value is this service's own; a template that writes an address, loads an image or runs anything is refused when it is saved.
template.subject: Subject
template.own: This realm has its own wording in {lang}.
template.builtIn: This is the built-in wording; saving it makes it this realm's own in the language you name.
template.isLink: is a link, and the text part must carry it.
